svg.text: Power-on to a story: who does what, in order (left to right)
The FPGA boots by itself from the QSPI flash (mode jumper on QSPI); make TOP=top_soc program_fw loads the same design over JTAG instead.
The model image gets onto the microSD card once: host/image_tool.py upload --store (UART -> DDR3, then SD_STORE writes it to the card, header last).
The CPU polls rather than waits for an interrupt; after READY it blocks on the console until a line arrives. /steps N and /trace PROMPT are the other commands.
